title: Merchant banking portal and transaction reporting APIs
workflow: Validate merchant KYB, contract and linked account mandate
Fetch authorized transaction history with explicit rail/source provenance
Separate authorization, capture, settlement and reconciliation in interface
Present fees and net proceeds with exact source versions
Submit refund/chargeback requests to independent approved workflow
Record reconciliation discrepancies and escalation cases
invariants: Merchant dashboard totals do not create bank deposits
Authorization/capture is not equivalent to externally settled cash
Refund request cannot mutate original posted financial record
Report must show currency, cutoff and source reconciliation state
Merchant may not query another seller's statement or customer data
Acquiring/PSP partner connection requires actual participation credentials
Use stable idempotency keys for merchant financial requests
acceptance_tests: Pending settlement not added to posted balance
Refund request duplicate does not duplicate refund
Fee total reconciles to approved tariff
Missing acquiring contract blocks production transaction
independent_gate: Acquiring/payment institution participation evidence, merchant KYB policy, settlement reconciliations and CFO/security review.
